notes:
POC objective: validate dedicated capacity that meets Crownhollow's throughput guarantees and latency SLOs for chat and reranking workloads.

Key technical targets (customer):
- Sustained throughput: 1,800 qps aggregate (peak bursts to 3k qps for 90s) across 6 nodes
- Latency SLOs: 95th <= 200ms, 99th <= 600ms for 4k token chat workflows
- Cost sensitivity: prefer predictable per-GPU reserved pricing, willing to trade model size for fewer GPUs if latency SLO holds

POC plan / tests executed so far:
- Baseline single-node microbenchmarks (A100-like equivalence): validate kernel selection and compilation flags
- Load Test 1: stepped ramps to 1k qps; found 99th tail spikes during cold KV cache misses
- Diagnostics: traced KV-cache misses to prefix caching not enabled in runtime for demo config; batching working (avg batch size 12)
- Soak plan: 72h on reserved pool (6 GPUs), 1k sustained qps for first 24h, then stepped to 1.8k for 24h, then 3k burst windows. Collect per-token cost, token efficiency, OOM incidence, and recovery time

Representative prompts used in tests (sanitized):
- Support chat thread: multi-turn, context length ~3k tokens, frequent function calls to internal KB
- Reranking set: 50 candidate passages, compute embeddings + pairwise scoring, strict 150ms per-request budget for rerank-only path
- Semantic search integration: small-doc retrieval + re-ranker pipeline, measure end-to-end p95

Open tech items / observations:
- Need explicit GPU SKU addendum in contract — customer requires guarantee that H100 equiv will be present or validated fallback latency is in contract
- Autoscaling policy: customer wants reserved pool but with burst to larger shared pool; need to show predictable cold-start bounds and fallback model variants
- Quantization: customer is open to int8 for reranking but not for chat without evals on hallucination risk

Commercial / legal notes:
- Customer asks for SLA credit triggers tied to 99th tail latency and per-month error budget. Legal wants Redwood's standard cap on damages but customer pushing for an uptime/latency credit schedule.
- Expected ARR band aligns with mid-enterprise dedicated booking. Finance requested discount ladder for 12/24 month reserved commitments.

Next steps (short):
- Finish 72h soak and upload consolidated perf report to /drive/pricing/crownhollow/benchmarks-20260305.pdf (SE deliverable)
summary: Enterprise POC for Dedicated capacity. Focus on throughput guarantees, latency SLO negotiation, and reserved GPU planning. Active soak and load testing in progress; security and contract items remain.
